description: Mark a Kanban task done as soon as its work is finished and verified, so the next session does not pick it up again. Records the completion time and keeps the task in history (amem_task_list with include_done shows it). Same as amem_task_update with status done. Returns the completed task as JSON; an unknown id returns an error.

id.description: Task id from amem_task_list or amem_task_add (task_…).

workspace.description: Workspace or repo name. Omit to use the repository the agent is running in.

name: amem_task_complete
